output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 9,906 to 6,568 characters (33.7%) and from 138 to 83 lines (39.9%). It follows mutation, reconciliation, restoration, navigation and publication boundaries. M denotes modular structure, C calls/transitions, O ownership/lifetime and D computational dependency. Seven peripherals give mechanisms a primary explanatory location; numeric limits and exception paths sit outside the overview.

Batch and patch details come from mappingDocumentController.ts and diagramConnection.ts. Geometry comes from lineGrid.ts and controller measurement handling. Canonical anchors, saved views and persistence come from canvasHistory.ts; runtime context ownership comes from canvasHistoryService.ts. Transfers come from canvasTransfer.ts. Details absent from the seed include patch-driven section removal, dirty comparisons ignoring viewport/selection, working-copy selection, candidate identity checks, canonical anchor encoding and change-entry sequencing.

Corrections: an empty native gesture calls updateSnapshot, whose reference-equality exits may skip a checkpoint. Opening the already-active named view stashes it and returns; stashing may append changed personal state, but does not restore a fresh target checkpoint. Failed staging does not append that batch, yet revision issuance may already have occurred, and settling a preceding editor gesture happens before validation. Move converts every source edge into a jump, including edges between unmoved placements. Both-head transfer guards apply to copy and move, while copy navigates only the destination.

The critique's overview/detail separation, meaningful attachments and proximity guidance are applied. Textual handoffs identify the diagrams, contexts and storage point IDs supplied by context.json. Recommendations requiring runtime, agent-API or chat evidence are not adopted because those implementations are outside the pinned inputs. Workspace publication, editor-driver wiring, revision-store internals, transfer-placement internals and checkpoint-encoder internals remain unshown. Call paths describe source-defined behavior, not observed execution.

Schema validation passed. All trees use printable ASCII/LF, all edge endpoints are valid meaningful 1-based lines, and every peripheral is connected. Measured rectangles do not overlap: horizontal gaps beside the central tree are at least 20 columns, and stacked peripherals have at least 3 blank rows. Rendered connector routing remains unverified.

|   |   |-- Includes links, sections, presentation and compiled context bindings
|   |   `-- Includes alternatives, revision selections and revision reviews

|-- Collision decisions
|   |-- Anchor changed child first at each ancestor

|   `-- Push right past settled obstacles plus the container gap
|-- Composition guards

Patch propagation and stale endpoint decisions
|-- patchDiagram receives nodeIds and lineAfter from revision edit
|   |-- Compose node correspondence across successive edits
|   |-- Reanchor edges matching old content and revision
|   |-- Rebase active jump sources only when their line survives
|   |-- Remap matching views' collapsed content-node IDs
|   `-- Remap section endpoints; drop section if either line is gone
|-- Edge creation/update contract
|   |-- Source: content node; target: content node or box
|   |-- New/changed endpoints require current node and revision
|   `-- Unchanged endpoint on update may keep a stale revision
`-- reconcileConnections compares before/after content
    |-- Removed placement -> drop incident edge
    |-- Already stale endpoint -> leave unchanged
    |-- Proven mapping to surviving node -> update ID and revision
    |-- Equal ASCII and structure -> match line and startColumn
    `-- No proven match -> retain stale endpoint without guessing

Canonical anchors reconstruct historical endpoints
|-- encodeAnchor follows placement -> content ID -> bound revision
|   |-- Current node ID becomes its logical revision.nodeRefs value
|   |-- Stored canonical anchor omits revisionId
|   `-- Already stale -> unresolvedAnchors stores original endpoint
|-- documentFromHistory decodes against the checkpoint's bindings
|   |-- Retained unresolved endpoint wins before logical lookup
|   |-- Otherwise reverse-lookup logical ref in bound nodeRefs
|   `-- No corresponding revision/node -> Unresolvable canonical anchor
|-- Validation rejects inconsistent canonical state
|   |-- Embedded scene.contents, wrong binding identity or bad parents
|   `-- Missing/duplicate logical node identities
`-- Validation mode determines when archived states are checked
    |-- 'all' validates the archive on load
    |-- 'current' validates current dependencies on load
    `-- Later document reads/navigation validate unchecked targets

Saved-view decisions and candidate publication
|-- Working copies and opening
|   |-- workingCopies maps view ID to unsaved checkpoint

|-- Branch and recording constraints
|   |-- fork opens child; alternatives creates children without opening

|-- Generation candidate checks

|   |-- Proposed history requires finished status and validation
|   `-- Import exact revisions; update candidate endpoint only
`-- promote-diffs consumes pinned endpoint comparison

Transfer identity, links and coordinated navigation
|-- Admission and identity
|   |-- Distinct canvases; nonempty unique diagram-only selection
|   |-- Retain relative positions; remap destination ID collisions
|   `-- contentIds map preserves sharing among selected placements
|-- Copy links
|   |-- Copy edges only when both endpoints are selected
|   |-- Give copied edges fresh IDs; validate their node endpoints
|   `-- Remap jump targets into selected destination placements
|-- Move links
|   |-- Convert EVERY source edge to a jump; clear source edges
|   |   `-- Includes edges between two unmoved placements

|-- Return prepared histories, views, selected IDs and transaction
|   `-- Workspace publication and placement helper internals unshown

Archive export and incremental persistence
|-- Current-only export
|   |-- Keep real head ID; omit checkpoint parent; empty past/future
|   |-- Keep direct checkpoint revision dependencies
|   |-- Omitted revision parents become identity boundaries
|   `-- Saved views or active recording force full-history export
|-- persistenceChanges(since)
|   |-- No cursor -> all records; cursor -> accumulated change entries
|   |-- sequence counts change entries, not canvas edits
|   |-- Append adds revision and snapshot entries separately
|   `-- Return current header even when no new checkpoint was added
|-- Transaction metadata changes also enter the change log
|   |-- linkTransaction replaces the head record with a transaction ID
